title: Returned-Payment Fee on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit
content:
A returned-payment fee is charged once per returned payment whose return code is in the tier's fee-bearing return codes, never more than the minimum payment due; for the line's most recent returned payment, and only for that return, the fee is the amount set under this policy in place of the tier's flat returned-payment fee, while a fee for any earlier return is still a flat returned-payment fee, and a return whose code is not in the fee-bearing return codes carries no fee. This applies to every line under FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.

## Booking

The fee is booked against the return it is charged for, dated the day it is booked, and added to the outstanding balance. A returned-payment fee that computes to 0.00 is still booked, as a 0.00 entry against its return.

| Return | Fee |
|---|---|
| code not in the fee-bearing return codes | none |
| fee-bearing code, the line's most recent returned payment | the amount set under this policy |
| fee-bearing code, any earlier return | the tier's flat returned-payment fee, never more than the minimum payment due |

## Booking tool: `assess_returned_payment_fee_0fd8e99d`

**What it does.** Books one returned-payment fee entry on the line, dated the current day and tied to the returned-payment entry it is charged for, and adds the fee to the line's outstanding balance. The borrower sees the new fee line on the account and the higher balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_returned_payment_fee_0fd8e99d` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `credit_line_id` — reference number of the FlexLine the fee is charged on, read from the FlexLine account lookup. Identifier.
- `related_txn_id` — reference number of the returned-payment entry the fee is charged for, read from the FlexLine entry lookup for that line. Identifier.
- `fee_amount` — the fee charged, in USD as a decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; no currency sign.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `line_txn_id` (reference number of the new fee entry), `related_txn_id` (the returned-payment entry it is tied to), `amount` (the fee, USD with 2 decimal places) and `outstanding_balance` (the line's balance including the fee, USD with 2 decimal places). The new `line_txn_id` confirms the fee was booked.
